title: Focus Now
behavior.hover.hint: Focus follows the pointer and scrolling workspaces center the focused column.
behavior.fullscreen.hint: Focused windows claim real fullscreen; other fullscreen windows on the workspace are restored.
behavior.near.hint: Focused windows take the selected share; neighboring windows share the remainder.
hint.noNeighbors: With no neighbor on an axis, the window claims the full width or height.
